text: Financial management is a discipline that focuses on the movement of funds within an enterprise. Its core lies in addressing the issue of "how to efficiently raise, allocate, utilize, and monitor funds to maximize the enterprise's value". It not only considers "where the money comes from and where it is used", but also pays more attention to optimizing business decisions through fund management (such as "whether to expand by borrowing" and "whether to invest in new projects"). It is the "financial core" of enterprise operation. Unlike accounting, which focuses on "documenting the past", financial management is more focused on "planning for the future", serving as a bridge connecting financial data with business strategies.
